αἰσθάνομαι: to perceive, apprehend by the senses, to see, hear, feel
αἴρω: to take up, raise, lift up
δηλέομαι: to hurt, do a mischief to
διηγέομαι: to set out in detail, describe in full
δύω: (trans.) cause to enter or sink (dunk); (intr.) enter; get into; sink; set (of sun/stars)
εὔχομαι: to pray, offer prayers, pay one’s vows, make a vow
θεάομαι: to look on, gaze at, view, behold
κατακτάομαι: to get for oneself entirely, gain possession of
καταλύω: to put down, destroy; settle (disputes); lodge, rest
κατεργάζομαι: to effect by labour, to achieve, accomplish
κείρω: to cut short, shear (hair); ravage, destroy
κομίζω: to take care of, provide for
κτάομαι: to procure for oneself, to get, gain, acquire
λέγω: to say, tell, speak; epic and arch.: pick, gather
λανθάνω: to escape notice, to be unknown, unseen, unnoticed
μέμφομαι: to blame, censure, find fault with
μεταβάλλω: to throw into a different position, to turn quickly
μεταχειρίζω: to take in hand, have in hand, conduct, pursue, treat
παραιτέομαι: to beg from, of; to avert, decline
πείθω: to prevail upon, win over, persuade
πελάζω: to approach, come near, draw near
περιγίγνομαι: to be superior to; to survive
προσγίγνομαι: to come in addition, to accrue, to support
προστίθημι: to add, to apply, to close (a door); mid. to join (a group), take as an ally
προσφθέγγομαι: to call to, address, accost, salute
σεύω: to put in quick motion: to drive, hunt, chase away
συμφράζομαι: to join in considering, to take counsel with
συσκευάζω: to make ready by putting together, to pack up
τεύχω: to make ready, make, build, work
τρέφω: to nourish, rear, maintain; congeal, curdle
φιτύω: to sow, plant, beget, call into being
χαίρω: to rejoice, be glad, be delighted
ἀλλάσσω: to make other than it is, to change, alter
ἀνέχω: to hold up; (mid.) endure, put up with
ἀνακαλέω: call on, invoke; call back, recall
ἀναπαύω: to make to cease, to stop
ἀπεργάζομαι: to finish off, turn out complete
ἀποδίδωμι: to give back, give what is due; (mid.) sell
ἀπονίναμαι: have the use or enjoyment of a thing
ἀφαιρέω: to take from, take away from
ἄρνυμαι: to receive for oneself, reap, win, gain, earn
ἅπτω: to fasten, bind fast; set on fire; mid. touch
ἐκγίγνομαι: to be born of; impers. supplementing ἔξεστι, it is allowed, granted
ἐκτίνω: to pay off, pay in full
ἐλαύνω: to drive, drive on, set in motion
ἐντύνω: to equip, deck out, get ready
ἐξακέομαι: to heal completely, heal the wound, make amends
ἐπιγίγνομαι: to be born after, come into being after
ἐπιμιμνήσκομαι: to remember, think of; to mention
ἐρύω: to drag along the ground, drag, draw
ἔχω: have, hold; be able; (+ adv.) be; (mid.) cling to, be next to (+ gen.)
ἱκνέομαι: to come, reach, approach; to supplicate, beseech; to befit
ἱμείρω: to long for, yearn after, desire
ὄλλυμι: to destroy, make an end of
ὄνομαι: to blame, find fault with, throw a slur upon, treat scornfully
ὑπεροπλίζομαι: to vanquish by force of arms
ὑφαιρέω: (lit. to seize underneath), take away, steal, take gradually, deduct
ὠθέω: to thrust, push, shove, force onwards
